title: Published Map
unavailableDetail: The link does not exist, was revoked by the author, has expired, or is not published yet.
degradedNotice: Some content was degraded per the publication scope (see disclosures).
notReady: Publication is still processing, please refresh later.
filterInvalid: Filter field is outside the published scope and was blocked
selectionEmpty: Click a feature on the map to see whitelisted attributes.
tableEmpty: No features match the current filter.
statsNote: Statistics come from the publication snapshot and the current filter; missing values are excluded from numeric stats.
colorblindUnchecked: Not checked — the author should verify with a color-vision check before publishing.
colorblindOk: Palette passes the separability check in the current context
colorblindFail: Palette fails the separability check (the author is advised to use a perceptually uniform palette)
readonlyNotice: Read-only view — this page provides no editing or analysis tools.
webglUnavailable: WebGL is unavailable in this environment — switched to the equivalent data-table view (same data as the map).
